_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate of ±2pt moves in 12h windows makes HOLD the statistically honest call, and neither brain has produced a concrete breaker signal strong enough to override that coil reality.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken analog structure and trapped longs; narrative implies directional upside via mean reversion but does not explicitly commit to a direction, creating a split between structural skepticism and pattern-optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND MVRV z-score climbs above 30 while BTC holds $62K — would signal institutional re-entry with valuation repair, allowing a shift toward Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spiking above 25 and funding staying positive — would mean forced unwinding of leveraged longs, pushing toward Panic
